upside.title: Upside stash: his role is growing before his points do
howto: **Upside stash**: a free agent whose role grew in his last one to three games (more snaps, targets or carries: a teammate out, a new starter) before his points caught up. **If it holds** is his projection with the bigger role: a what-if, not a forecast.
**Lineup gain if it holds** adds up this week and the next three in your lineup; most stashes add nothing yet, which is why they are stashes, not starters.
